Dear Larkspur team,

I wanted to inquire about hiring the 1959 Pemberley Countess for a client event. We plan to collect the vehicle on 17/03/2027 at 08:00 and return it on 19 March 2027 at 12:00. We will be picking it up from your garage. It would be appreciated if one of your chauffeurs could be driving. I have attached my driving licence for your reference.

Kind regards,
Tess Ashgrove
+70 221 288 5204
